notes.title: 🔊 Patch Update Announcement 🔊
notes.notes:
🔊 Patch Update Announcement 🔊


Greetings, fellow gamers!

We’re happy to announce our latest patch update, packed with exciting enhancements and additions to elevate your gaming experience. Here’s what’s new:

- SFX volume has been fine-tuned for optimal gameplay experience.

- When all weapons and items are maxed out, players will now receive coins upon leveling up, adding an extra layer of reward and progression.



Additions:

- Introducing temporary buff elements randomly scattered throughout the map! These buffs will enhance your powers, providing strategic advantages during gameplay.




We're committed to continually improving and enhancing your gaming experience. Thank you for your support and feedback. Enjoy the updated features, and see you in the game!


﻿

notes.title: Patch update
notes.notes:
📣 Attention Steam Community! Patch Update Incoming!

🛠️ We've got some exciting fixes and additions in store for you:

1.  Boss AI Adjustment: The boss won't change direction excessively when in close proximity to the player.

2. Fist Evolution Fix: Addressed the issue where fist evolution didn't face the correct direction.

3. German Language Support: We've added German language localization for our German-speaking players.

4. Boss Difficulty Ramp-up: Brace yourselves! The boss will become more challenging when its HP drops below 30%.

5. Enhanced Resolution Options: Enjoy more flexibility with additional resolution settings.

6. Increased Rewards: Get ready to cash in! We've increased the gain from coin and bag pickups.

7. Legend Bar Enhancement: Keep an eye on your progress - the legend bar will now fill up when hitting the boss.

8. Improved Enemy Maneuvers: Beware of intricate hive formations! Test your reflexes as you dodge through challenging enemy formations.

Thank you always for your support !

Stay tuned for more updates and happy gaming! 🚀

notes.title: Patch Announcement
notes.notes:
We're happy to share that our team has addressed the time barrier achievement and introduced a feature for capturing your progress through screenshots support.

* Achievements are no longer tied to time barriers.
* Screenshot support.

Thank you for all your valuable feedback! Your insights have been instrumental in shaping a better gaming experience for everyone. Keep those thoughts coming as we continue to evolve and enhance. Together, we level up!
